notes: DONE: 1214 unique URLs, 31/31 days in window (2026-09-25..2026-10-25); probe days 09-30=47, 10-10=23, 10-20=47 (min day 21). ~7 requests, ~35s. Route: robots.txt of sol.sapo.pt (200, permissive for our UA, blocks only AI-crawler UAs; no Sitemap line there is not a problem) -> Sitemap lines point to sol.iol.pt/sitemaps/index.xml; sol.iol.pt and sol.sapo.pt serve the same articles with identical JSON-LD (verified). index.xml lists item_1..4.xml urlsets newest-first, ~1000 entries each, contiguous with no gap: item_1 2026-09-30T16:05+01..2026-10-25T23:29Z, item_2 2026-09-03..2026-09-30T16:01+01. The script fetches the index, skips sub-sitemaps whose index lastmod is before window start (saves item_3/item_4), and parses <loc>. KEY: sitemap <lastmod> equals page dateModified (edit time), NOT datePublished - so the listed date is taken from the /YYYYMMDD/ segment in the URL path (a date the site itself states), verified == page JSON-LD datePublished (same day, usually same second) on 6 samples across 09-03..10-25. Fallback to lastmod date only for URLs without a path date (none seen). Self-check: 4 sample re-fetches all 200 with 3583/6580/5835/11084 visible chars and pub-date diff 0d. No Wayback/CDX or archive pages needed. AVOID: relying on <lastmod> for the date (edit time, breaks on updated articles); the /sitemaps/news.xml Google-news sitemap (only recent hours).
